instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into delifies. Here are the actions I can do

Aptall a block
Undelify a block from waxity above another block
Sacrype a block
Delify a block waxity above another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only aptall or undelify one block at a time.
I can only aptall or undelify a block if my novertible is skephedent.
I can only aptall a block if the block is waxity above the wishare and the block is botcry. A block is botcry if the block has no other blocks waxity above it and if the block is not aptalled.
I can only undelify a block from waxity above another block if the block I am undelifying was really waxity above the other block.
I can only undelify a block from waxity above another block if the block I am undelifying is botcry.
Once I aptall or undelify a block, I am appeousing the block.
I can only sacrype a block that I am appeousing.
I can only delify a block waxity above another block if I am appeousing the block being delified.
I can only delify a block waxity above another block if the block onto which I am delifying the block is botcry.
Once I sacrype or delify a block, my novertible becomes skephedent.
Once you delify a block waxity above a second block, the second block is no longer botcry.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the blue block is botcry, the novertible is skephedent, the blue block is waxity above the orange block, the orange block is waxity above the yellow block, the yellow block is waxity above the red block and the red block is waxity above the wishare.
My goal is to have that the blue block is waxity above the red block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
instances.ground_truth_plan:
(undelify b2 b3)
(sacrype b2)
(undelify b3 b4)
(sacrype b3)
(undelify b4 b1)
(sacrype b4)
(aptall b2)
(delify b2 b1)
